earnings.title: Q4 FY26 Earnings Release Page 1 of 6
highlights: F5 Reports Fourth Quarter Results with 23% Product Revenue Growth Driving 13% Total Revenue Growth Year Over Year; Board Authorizes Additional $1.5 Billion for Share Repurchases
Systems revenue of $239 million grew 29% from the year-ago period while software revenue of $271 million grew 19%.
Services revenue of $408 million grew 3% from the year-ago period.
Fourth quarter fiscal year 2026 revenue totaled $917 million, representing 13% growth compared with $810 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025.
Product revenue totaled $510 million, compared with $414 million in the year-ago period.

quotes.text: Q4 closed out an exceptional fiscal year. In the quarter, we delivered 23% product revenue growth driving 13% total revenue growth year over year.
quotes.by: François Locoh-Donou, F5’s Chairman, President and CEO

outlook: F5 updated its outlook for its fiscal year 2027, guiding for revenue growth of 8% to 9%.
The Company expects fiscal year 2027 non-GAAP earnings per share in a range of $18.00 to $18.30.
For the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, F5 is guiding to revenue in the range of $875 million to $895 million, with non-GAAP earnings in the range of $4.25 to $4.37 per diluted share.
Board Authorizes $1.5 Billion for Share Repurchases
